setlist:
Digitally Remastered using the Bertha Digital Audio Workstation by jashley@deadacated.com. Completed 6/8/2009
Frequency analysis shows a change in the analog fingerprint at around 1:35:15. There also appears to be a crossfade at this point. The first half fingerprint continues on past 22khz and the second half fingerprint rolls off at 20khz. The second half is slightly compressed, which can be seen in wave analysis. It's not clear if these are from two different sources but the fingerprints are clearly different.
Due to the difference between the two halves each was processed separately to create a even sound between the two.
Enjoy!

title: Grateful Dead Live at Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA on 1991-05-10
setlist:
Notes:
Some initial fluctuations in the SBD mix at the beginnings of the sets. The sound improves in set 1 with They Love Each Other.
A loud drum boom was reduced in Jack Straw.
The #149676 SBD CM patches a dropout in Cold Rain and Snow (transfer by Charlie Miller, 4/24/20).
EQ was used to address some boominess in the AUD and two sections of extended high end in the SBD.
SBD levels changed at times (more significantly with part of Sugar Magnolia and all of Baby Blue), for which adjustments were made.
About a 1:10 segment was repeated during the Space > Wheel transition in the SBD source and was removed.
Some clicks and pops were removed. A moment of digi-static was removed at 3:03 in Foolish Heart.
The SBD was so darn dry that even the matrix comes off as a little dry at times, but there really is a significant improvement here if one compares it to the original soundboard source. The SBD/AUD mix is pretty standard ratio, and compensatory level adjustments were made as needed.
Awesome '91 show! Great second set! Nice choice, Dan!
subject: Soundboard;Matrix;Hunter Seamons
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Soundtrack Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Soundtrack > Final Cut for pre- and post-mix EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) December 27, 2023
